brief: fresh blind judge on the W1-22 audio SAME/DIFFERENT pack B2 (32 trials, seed 22071)
role: blind judge - MUST NOT read W1-22 verdict, W1-22 status files, critic-w1-22 status, RI-AUD* items, or game/data audio data
findings: Contention at start: pgrep -c headless_shell = 30, loadavg 20.28 on 4 cores. Well above the protocol cap of ~8. Doing all offline work first; will not take a browser unless the pack requires one.
Pack ALREADY BUILT at reports/w1-22-critic/b2 (pack_id w1-22-b2-78aebc7, 32 trials, seed 22071, commit 78aebc7 dirty). No need to render -- avoids a browser entirely under load 20.

LEAK 1 (author missed): reports/w1-22-critic/b2/JUDGE.md lives INSIDE the pack directory and states 'separation over the 24 DIFFERENT trials, and false_different_rate over the 8 SAME trials'. PROMPT.md explicitly promises 'You are not told how many of each.' The pack contradicts its own prompt. RI-MTH03 SectionA says the pack contains only the artifacts + PROMPT.md + pack.json; operator notes belong in the reveal sibling.

LEAK 2 (author missed): audio-pack-b2.mjs hardcodes hard=12, random=12, catch=8, so the class balance is recoverable from the builder source -- which the judge's own brief instructs it to read and audit.

LEAK 3 (author missed): audio-pack-b2.mjs lines 249-250 print catch-pair proxy distances and hard-stratum distances to STDOUT at build time. Anyone who builds the pack and reads the console sees the numeric separation between the SAME and DIFFERENT strata, which calibrates a threshold exactly. Should be written into the reveal directory, not stdout.

LEAK CHECKED, CLEAN: crest_factor_db uses the TRUE lufsI() while loudness_lufs is hardcoded -23.0. Crest factor = peak/RMS is scale-invariant, so it does NOT reopen the loudness channel the author closed. Verified algebraically from the source.
findings_2: PACK INTEGRITY DEFECT: pack.json trials_sha256=3ab1e3b8... does NOT match trials.json on disk (recomputed 14684a7c...). Cause identified: trials.json contains the literal token -23.0 sixty-four times, a form JSON.stringify cannot emit (it emits -23). The file was text-substituted after the tool wrote it, so the declared hash is the hash of the ORIGINAL leaky build. Blinding is intact (all 64 values are the same constant, no residual variance) but RI-MTH03 M3's auditability claim is broken for this pack.

RESULT IS ROBUST: two independent metrics agree exactly. Mean absolute band difference puts 8 trials at 0.14-0.95 dB and the next at 4.39 dB (4.6x gap). Cosine distance on linear band power puts the SAME 8 at 0.00001-0.00105 and the next at 0.15185 (145x gap). Identical partition, no threshold tuning possible.

ZERO transient onsets across all 64 recordings in the pack. One of the four channels the pack advertises carries no information anywhere. Corroborated detector-free by crest factor, which spans only 10.0-17.4 dB across all clips - consistent with steady noise/drone beds, not with discrete one-shot events (which push crest above ~20 dB).

13 acoustic identities recovered by clustering the 24 distinct band-vectors (11 regions present at both capture seeds, 2 at one). 13 regions gives C(13,2)=78 pairs, matching the tool docstring's '78 pairs'.
NO TWO REGIONS ARE INDISTINGUISHABLE. The closest distinct-region pair in the pack (T22) is 4.39 dB mean / 0.152 cosine apart, still 145x further than the closest same-region re-roll.

Stereo correlation spans 0.001 to 0.999 across the 24 distinct clips; 7 of 24 sit above 0.989, i.e. effectively mono with no stereo image at all, while others are fully decorrelated. Spatial treatment is inconsistent between regions.
